post.description:
Creates the real `Investigation` row synchronously (so the
caller gets a real id back immediately), then hands the real work
off to a background task -- a real async job, using the row's own
`state`/`final_status` columns as its real job status, never a
second, parallel job-tracking table.

get.description:
Real open tasks whose owning investigation is visible under the
caller's own real RLS tenant scope -- the JOIN down to
`investigations` is what makes this tenant-safe: Postgres applies
`investigations`' own real RLS policy to every row the join
touches, same as any other query against that table.
